instruments.notes: Swap on Congo production hedging basis differential between No. 6 fuel oil and WTI at average differential of $2.28. Period stated only as 'For 1999'. Fair value of all derivatives combined at 12/31/98 was a loss of $2.4 million (not split by instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
For 1999, the Company entered into swap agreements
on 4,500 barrels of oil per day ("BOPD") of its Congo production, hedging the
basis differential between No. 6 fuel oil and West Texas Intermediate ("WTI") at
an average differential of $2.28.

instruments.notes: Purchased call on Congo production at $16.00 strike to hedge potential liability under a price sharing agreement with a third party. Period stated only as 'For 1999'. Fair value of all derivatives combined at 12/31/98 was a loss of $2.4 million (not split by instrument).
instruments.evidence_quote:
The Company also purchased a call option on
2,000 BOPD of its Congo production at a strike price of $16.00 per barrel of oil
("BBL"), to hedge the Company's potential liability under a price sharing
agreement with a third party.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Company periodically seeks to reduce exposure to price volatility by hedging production through swaps, options and other commodity derivatives; uses hedge accounting.
